name: Bookmark Health Master (BHM-PRO)
tagline: Clean & Organize 1,000+ Bookmarks in Seconds. Zero False 404s. Zero Cloud Uploads.
description: High-performance, privacy-first Chrome SidePanel extension for bookmark dead link verification via DNS-over-HTTPS, exact URL-preserving deduplication, automated 16 Cloud & Dev Ecosystems clustering with Protected Folder Whitelists and Personal Custom Domain Rules, Auth-Gated Cloud Docs isolation, and sibling-anchor atomic 1-click rollback.

architecture.deduplication: Exact URL-preserving normalization (retains query parameters and hash fragments to prevent false merges)
architecture.clustering: Personal Custom Domain Rules (highest priority) + Protected Folder Whitelists + Default Loose-Bookmark Safe Scope + 16 Cloud & Dev Ecosystems + Auth-Gated Cloud Docs & Workspaces Isolation
architecture.rollback: Atomic Sibling-Anchor MoveJournal with 100% index and parent fidelity
architecture.licensing: 100% Offline Ed25519 WebCrypto Public-Key Digital Signature Verification
